build_fairseq_package: build and install the fairseq sequence-to-sequence toolkit with C++ and CUDA extensions
run_write_version_py: run write_version_py to generate fairseq/version.py with the current git commit hash
create_numpy_extension: create a NumpyExtension subclass of setuptools Extension that auto-includes numpy header directories
run_get_files: run get_files to recursively walk a directory path and return a list of non-pyc files
run_do_setup: run do_setup with package_data to invoke setuptools setup and install fairseq with CLI entry points
